02 / The person behind the pixels

A designer’s eye.
An engineer’s mind.

I’m Gerald Donkor, a design engineer based in Ghana. I work in the space between how something looks and how it works.

I design and build polished, interactive web experiences—bringing thoughtful interfaces, expressive motion, and strong frontend engineering together.

A little more about me on GitHub
My default settingBuilding with taste :)

Clear hierarchy, considered layouts, and components that work together. I turn complex requirements into interfaces people can navigate with confidence.

FigmaPrototypingDesign systems

Responsive interfaces and reusable components, built with TypeScript and a careful approach to architecture. Good design deserves equally thoughtful implementation.

ReactNext.jsTypeScriptTailwind CSS

Motion gives an interface rhythm and helps every action feel connected. From a tiny hover state to a choreographed page, I care about how it feels to use.
